children: Boise Cascade said it plans to acquire a pair of building materials distribution facilities in California from Taiga Building Products.

The facilities are located in Rocklin, about 22 miles northeast of Sacramento, and in Sanger, which is in California's Central Valley near Fresno. Boise Cascade said the locations will strengthen its ability to serve customers in Northern and Central California, the California Coast, and Northern Nevada.
Boise Cascade is a wholesale distributors of building materials and also makes engineered wood products and plywood in North America.
The acquisition will also strengthen Boise Cascade's general product line capabilities, and support the continued growth of its recently expanded partnership with James Hardie, the company added.
The deal is expected to close by the middle of the month.
Taiga Building will continue to own and operate its other facilities in the state.
